career.title: Software Engineer at Holiday Channel
career.text: Since June 2026, I have been a Software Engineer at Holiday Channel in Colorado. I built a serverless Lambda classifier using hash-map keyword matching to tag more than 30,000 recipes, saving about 30 hours of weekly editorial effort. I also automated weekly ingestion of more than 1,000 media assets into S3 with synchronized PostgreSQL writes.

career.title: Software Engineer Intern at Holiday Channel
career.text: I was a Software Engineer Intern at Holiday Channel from May to August 2025. I reduced recipe API latency from 500 ms to 150 ms with Redis caching and paginated filters, resolved a client-side routing bug, and supported content operations across Strapi, Render, S3, and Figma.

career.title: Software Development Engineer at Wiz Freight
career.text: I worked as a Software Development Engineer at Wiz Freight from March 2022 to July 2024. I built an automated pricing engine that reduced quote turnaround from four hours to under one minute for about 1,000 daily shipments. I also reduced a Go dashboard API's p99 latency from three seconds to 600 ms and improved PostgreSQL query paths.

career.title: Programmer Analyst Intern at Cognizant

profile.text: I am Nikhil Saji, a software engineer based in Virginia. I have more than two years of production experience in distributed systems and backend services, with Go, Python, Java, PostgreSQL, and AWS. I also build AI agents and full-stack products.

profile.title: Skills and technologies
profile.text: My public portfolio lists Go, Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, gRPC, WebSockets, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Next.js, and React among my tools and technologies.

featured_projects.title: SyncBeat
featured_projects.text: I built SyncBeat, a distributed group-listening platform. Its Spring Boot mainframe provides REST and STOMP/WebSocket room interactions; Redis and a Python state-sync worker support synchronized playback, and an analytics worker processes events. Audio streams from private S3 through CloudFront signed URLs. SNS fans events out to FIFO SQS queues. The web frontend is built with Next.js.

featured_projects.title: Portfolio RAG Agent
featured_projects.text: I built this portfolio chat service in Python. The current version uses direct fact lookup, lexical search, and Pinecone dense search over approved career and project facts, followed by one answer call. Redis session memory is optional, and the API runs on AWS Lambda. The earlier LangGraph routing pipeline was retired in this rebuild.

featured_projects.title: Expensely
featured_projects.text: I built Expensely, a personal finance platform with a Next.js frontend and Java Spring Boot backend. It supports expense and income tracking, budgets, recurring transactions, dashboards, OAuth/JWT authentication, and real-time notifications, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

featured_projects.title: Job Tracker
featured_projects.text: I built Job Tracker, a job discovery and application workflow with a Go backend, PostgreSQL, and a web dashboard. The documented pipeline collects listings, filters eligibility, and uses an LLM to score opportunities; the backend also exposes job events through SSE.

featured_projects.title: Talky Space
featured_projects.text: I built Talky Space, a real-time chat application with a Next.js frontend and Go backend using WebSockets.

featured_projects.title: Gatekeeper
featured_projects.text: I built Gatekeeper, an authentication project with a React frontend and Node.js backend. It covers JWT sessions and role-based access control.

featured_projects.title: Neural Networks
featured_projects.text: I worked on custom neural network architectures and VGG-13 image classification experiments.
